## Airbnb - Senior Software Engineer – Guest & Host

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb/jobs/8249626)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building backend identity, authorization, and privacy systems for Airbnb’s global lodging platform. Scaling migrations, APIs, and infrastructure used across product teams.
Senior Software Engineer building identity and privacy systems for Airbnb’s global lodging platform
- Tech stack: Java, Kotlin, Microservices
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors UK Skilled Worker visas.
- Build and scale backend systems supporting user identity and privacy
- Design and build backend services and APIs enforcing identity and privacy rules across product surfaces
- Contribute to large-scale migrations from legacy identity patterns
- Build tooling that makes migrations safe to run broadly
- Define and evolve authorization logic for context-scoped data access
- Partner with teams building messaging, trips, profile, and related systems
- Participate in design and code reviews
- Debug and resolve production issues through structured root-cause analysis
- 6+ years of professional backend software engineering experience
- Strong fundamentals in service-oriented architecture, API design, and data modeling
- Proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin
- Comfort working within a microservices environment, including RPC frameworks, service IDLs, and dependency injection
- Experience designing systems with correctness and authorization as first-class concerns
- Track record of shipping migrations or infrastructure changes used by other teams
- Attention to backward compatibility and rollout safety
- Strong written communication

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building backend identity, authorization, and privacy systems for Airbnb’s global lodging platform. Scaling migrations, APIs, and infrastructure used across product teams.
Senior Software Engineer building identity and privacy systems for Airbnb’s global lodging platform
Role description:
• Build and scale backend systems supporting user identity and privacy
• Design and build backend services and APIs enforcing identity and privacy rules across product surfaces
• Contribute to large-scale migrations from legacy identity patterns
• Build tooling that makes migrations safe to run broadly
• Define and evolve authorization logic for context-scoped data access
• Partner with teams building messaging, trips, profile, and related systems
• Participate in design and code reviews
• Debug and resolve production issues through structured root-cause analysis
Role requirements:
• 6+ years of professional backend software engineering experience
• Strong fundamentals in service-oriented architecture, API design, and data modeling
• Proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin
• Comfort working within a microservices environment, including RPC frameworks, service IDLs, and dependency injection
• Experience designing systems with correctness and authorization as first-class concerns
• Track record of shipping migrations or infrastructure changes used by other teams
• Attention to backward compatibility and rollout safety
• Strong written communication
• Ability to document problems, root causes, and solution trade-offs clearly
• Comfort turning complex, evolving privacy or identity requirements into concrete technical designs
• Must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity
Benefits:
• Occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager
• Reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities
Tech stack:
Java, Kotlin, Microservices
